dispositions.rationale: auth-session has no independent listener; external requests reach it only through the express-backend HTTP ingress (candidate-1), then through the in-process JWT verification interface (candidate-2).
Express HTTP listener at port 3000 is the confirmed network ingress; per-route isAuthorized() expressJwt middleware is the enforcement control.
